title: THE SMOKE CLOUD IS 1.3 TIMES BIGGER
why: His order of 2026-10-13: the smoke grenade should cover a bigger area, about 1.3 times what it did. A thrown Smoke Canister now opens a cloud 1.3 times as wide (a radius of about 21 metres where it was 16.5), so there is more cloud to stand in. The cloud a pillager drops when he is hurt or running, and the cloud your party sees when someone else throws one, are the same size. The line of sight it blocks reaches the same 1.3 times further out and the grey puffs are drawn to match, so what you see is what hides you. It still lasts 12 seconds.
now: A Smoke Canister now covers 1.3 times the ground it did, so there is more cloud to hide in.
